notes:
The recorder now draws the real mouse pointer, not a generic marker. Scrap
Mechanic uses an open hand when you hover a slot and a closed fist while you
are dragging an item, and that difference is the whole point: it is what
separates picking something up from putting it down. Both are now in the
recording, each with its own colour so the difference survives at training
resolution.

The version is shown in the window title. If something goes wrong, the
screenshot now says which build it was.
